name: sargam-icons
description: Handcrafted, optimized icons for better performance.

scripts.compress: rimraf Icons/Duotone Icons/Fill Icons/Line && svgo -f ./src/assets/Duotone -o ./Icons/Duotone && svgo -f ./src/assets/Fill -o ./Icons/Fill && svgo -f ./src/assets/Line -o ./Icons/Line
scripts.generate:packages: bun run tools/generate/emit/vue.ts && bun run tools/generate/emit/solid.ts && bun run tools/generate/emit/svelte.ts && bun run tools/generate/emit/astro.ts && bun run tools/generate/emit/static.ts
scripts.generate:all: bun run generate && bun run --filter '@sargamicons/react' generate && bun run --filter '@sargamicons/preact' generate && bun run generate:packages
scripts.build:all: bun run generate && bun run build:packages
scripts.build: bun run generate-template && bunx rspack build
scripts.build:dev: bun run generate-template && bunx rspack build --mode development
scripts.dev: bun run generate-template && bunx rspack serve
scripts.preview: bun run build && bunx serve dist

author: @planetabhi
